Container.Name: Lucia
Container.Overview: Privacy-first Home Assistant agent platform with its dashboard and Wyoming voice server. Before installing, run `docker network create lucia` in the Unraid terminal, then install the Lucia PostgreSQL and Redis templates.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: home assistant ai agent wyoming voice automation
Container.Requires: Before installing, run `docker network create lucia` in the Unraid terminal. Install Lucia-PostgreSQL and Lucia-Redis first. The PostgreSQL password must match all three connection strings.
